name: Redemption/Temptation, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric 9, oracle 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour
Components V, S, M (burning incense), DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will partial (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This works as redemption/temptation, except it is a transmutation spell, operating on the subject’s very soul instead of its mind. This variant of the spell works on outsiders and creatures with an alignment subtype and the subject’s original alignment can only be restored by divine intervention. A separate casting of redemption/temptation, greater redemption/temptation or the “redemption or temptation” version of atonement by a caster of a different alignment can still alter the subject’s alignment normally, but works by changing their alignment to match the caster instead of returning the subject’s alignment to its original state.
